reason_for_amendment: Correct the v2 adapter entry-point list so separate preregistered board and season seeds can both be honored. No hypothesis, formula, arm, configuration, seed, metric, threshold, evidence rule, or failure disposition changes.

replaces_v2_adapter_fields.pairing_reduction: For each season, config, board_seed, season_seed and seat, subtract the control outcome in the mirrored run from the candidate outcome in the other run. Reduce the resulting raw paired vectors directly with mean and normal-approximation CI95. paired_ci is not applicable because candidate and control occupy complementary seats in two result objects.
replaces_v2_adapter_fields.seed_mapping: draft_league(seed=board_seed) creates each mirrored roster set; evaluate_rosters(config=EvalConfig(n_seasons=1, seed=season_seed, frozen C02C waiver knobs)) evaluates it. Both parity runs receive identical player pool, row, board seed, and season seed.

execution_rule: Commit v3 alone before production behavior edits. Read v1, v2, and v3 cumulatively, with only the named v2 adapter fields replaced.
